Premium Bowling Version 1.30.0 is here! 

In this update, we’ve introduced new full body avatars that let you enjoy the game from head to toe. We also added force feedback that brings every throw to life. notes.title: Route 66 Alley
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33556918/010308c1bbfe86573e636d59182d8da8eb99534b.jpg[/img]

Hit the Open Road with Our First DLC Alley – Welcome to Route 66!

Our first DLC alley is here, and it’s taking Premium Bowling on a scenic drive straight to the heart of the desert. Introducing Route 66 Alley – a one-of-a-kind open-air bowling experience that blends the rugged charm of the old American highway with the timeless thrill of the lanes. Imagine stepping into a desolate desert where the blazing sun illuminates golden sands, rusted cars tell tales of a bygone era, and a weathered gas station stands as a nostalgic landmark. That’s Route 66 Alley!

We also added a new 45ft Wyvern oil pattern, technology updates and a host of small improvements to make your experience smoother and more immersive than ever!

[*] Paradise Island Perfection: Enjoy a fully upgraded, sun-drenched paradise that’s always in season. We’ve fine-tuned the visuals and lighting to make every throw feel like a mini-vacation. Trade chilly winds for an ocean breeze every time you bowl!
[*] Enhanced Pin Setters: Seamless, faster, and better than ever – the pin setters have been optimized for smoother gameplay, so you can focus on hitting that strike without a hitch.
[*] Added 5 new oilpatterns.
[*] Added option to hide side user-interface panels.  Activate it from VR Options -> Side Panels: Visible / Hidden
[/list]

notes.title: Holiday Update 1.11 Available Now!
notes.notes:
This is a giant leap for Premium Bowling! We added Controller Support which makes sofa play possible. Secondly, now our players can enjoy majestetic mountain views while bowling at our new Mountain Retreat alley. The alley has 8 lanes so it's also great for large online multiplayer parties with friends.

And There's More:

 - Player Ranking is now more interesting as it's thrown on different oil pattern every week 
 - Ambient sounds and crowd chatter added to alleys
 - Support for left handed throwing added to mouse play
 - Timers off option added to online challenge to allow friendly playing without time pressure
 - Fixes to bugs like remote players moving to wrong lanes, floating balls, and others... 

We welcome all feedback and wish everyone happy holidays! Get in contact with us at our Discord Server or Community Hub and let's make Premium Bowling even better next year!!

notes.notes:
This version comes with heavily improved online gaming and live spectators. Now it's possible to challenge other players to multiplayer competition.. or just wait for competition proposals to pop up and accept or reject them. Spectators are unique individuals, simulated with AI. They follow the game and react to game events. 

Live crowd wraps up our proof-of-concept for avatars. In the next version we are planning to take the final step and implement player avatars using the same technology! Join the development discussion in our discord server or community hub!

notes.title: Version 1.3 with Leagues and Merits Released!
notes.notes:
Premium Bowling 1.3 with Leagues and Merits is out now! Competing in leagues and hunting merits is yet another exciting way to enjoy the game.

- Weekly Leagues have one and Monthly Leagues more events. Events define the hall and oil pattern to be used and players have only a few official series attempts in each event. Winner of a league is the player who scores the highest sum over all events. 

- Players have ELO-style League Points that are awarded from leagues to players who were involved in the league. There is a Global League Top that updates after each league. 

- Permanent Merits are given for Top 3 league finishes and Top 5 weekly rankings (subject to change in the future). Merits, league history, and other interesting stats about the player are shown in Player Info View which can be accessed by clicking player's name in top listings and league player listings. 

Next up will be Paradise Island level and custom balls. We'll tell more about them in the Steam Community Hub / Reddit / Discord!

notes.title: Version 1.2 with Retro Lanes has landed!
notes.notes:
This version is one giant leap for the game and comes with a divine looking Retro Lanes bowling alley. We have also continued towards ultimate realism and full bowling experience by adding and improving sounds, throwing and physics. Based on feedback from pro level bowlers, normal throw speed and lane friction have both been reduced to more typical levels. Throwing in virtual reality feels even more real. 

Demo has been extended to allow 12 games or 1 hour of playing, which ever lasts longer.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Released!
notes.notes:
This version improves physics, greatly improves VR throw control, fixes a couple of bugs and adds features that our players have requested. 

 * Now it's possible to hide or completely disable VR Aim
 * Option to change play area orientation in VR from Settings 
 * Option to see hand trajectory after throwing in VR
 * Option to lock play area in VR
 * Oilpattern visibility is now persistent 
 * Thrower position indicator on floor (shadow)
 * Heavier balls are thrown a bit slower than light ones
 * Camera angle change timing improved
 * Improved throwing instructions
 * Fixed a crash that was caused by NaNs in physics simulation

We have got a lot of feedback requesting features for making the player feel even more like being inside a bowling hall. Like pin machine sounds, working ball return machine and picking the ball up from the ball return machine, improvements to sounds and so on. We just want to say that we have heard your feedback (Thank You!) and we'll work on "immersion improvements" in the next update.

notes.title: Early Access Version Available Now!
notes.notes:
Premium Bowling is a leisurable and realistic ten pin bowling experience that players can enjoy together locally or in network, in VR or with mouse and a display. 

Join us now to take advantage of our early access price! You'll also have maximum time to give your input and affect future development of the game.

You can try Premium Bowling for free by downloading one hour full featured demo.
